title: SB 920 (2019-2020 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): suspending the requirement to provide identification to vote at an election during a state of emergency.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.41 (created)
(quote) Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary, no elector is required to provide identification in order to vote at any primary or election held within 90 days after the day on which the governor issues an executive order declaring a state of emergency, as provided under s. 323.10.
